title: ACP Delegate Payment: allowance scoping and enforcement
summary: The agent turns a card into a vault token bound by an allowance. The PSP, not ACP, enforces the limits; ACP defines no error code for an out-of-allowance charge.

steps.label: POST /agentic_commerce/delegate_payment
steps.detail: Headers: Authorization, API-Version and Idempotency-Key are required. RFC section 2.2 says the client must sign with Signature and Timestamp; the header list and OpenAPI mark them optional.

payload.content:
# Illustrative example, spec version 2026-04-17.
POST /agentic_commerce/delegate_payment HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <api-key>
API-Version: 2026-04-17
Idempotency-Key: idem_001
Content-Type: application/json
Signature: <base64url detached signature>
Timestamp: 2026-10-11T17:29:59Z

{
  "payment_method": {
    "type": "card",
    "card_number_type": "network_token",
    "number": "4000000000000002",
    "display_card_funding_type": "credit",
    "metadata": {}
  },
  "allowance": {
    "reason": "one_time",
    "max_amount": 330,
    "currency": "usd",
    "checkout_session_id": "cs_123",
    "merchant_id": "merchant_abc",
    "expires_at": "2026-10-11T18:00:00Z"
  },
  "risk_signals": [],
  "metadata": {}
}

steps.label: Store card, bind allowance
steps.detail: The PSP or vault keeps the card and records reason one_time, max_amount, currency, checkout_session_id, merchant_id and expires_at against the token.

steps.label: 201 { id: vt_... }
steps.detail: Only an opaque token returns to the agent.

steps.label: Charge up to the allowance
steps.detail: The merchant PSP charges the token. Wrong merchant, wrong session, an amount above max_amount, a second use or a charge after expires_at should fail, but the error is PSP specific.

failures.outcome: Declined by the PSP; no ACP error code
